entries.name: Anti-Cavalry Doctrine V
entries.text: -35% DMG taken from cavalry while bracing, +DMG vs cavalry while bracing. Mandatory per OP.

entries.name: Anti-Cavalry Brace Doctrine
entries.text: -30% DMG taken from cavalry when using Brace-type skills. Mandatory per OP.

entries.name: Bloodthirsty Doctrine
entries.text: Lifesteal + 12% DMG, alt for Piercing. Mandatory per OP.

entries.name: Piercing Damage Doctrine
entries.text: +80 piercing DMG, +120 piercing AP. Mandatory per OP.

entries.name: Bleeding Brace Doctrine
entries.text: Bracing inflicts bleeding on enemy cavalry: 16% max HP + 400 DMG. Filler.

doctrines.note: No "Top Pick" doctrine tier present — OP only gives Mandatory / Filler / Don't put (not fabricated). This is the Halberdiers unit (distinct from Halberd Elite, a separate shortlisted unit — not conflated here). Veterancy: Full Bot. Hero pairing: not specified in this thread. Playstyle: if you can manage to move from F2 to F2 in fight and let it brace, that's best (F2 requires all unit models to be at the X-move position); if too hard or the fight moves too fast, swap to F1 and insta-brace — also move them in F1 in case an insta-brace is needed. "Don't put" is a literal X placeholder in the OP — not fabricated.
